about: Every addition first-draft makes to a plain model call, with the paired, rendered comparison that justifies it. tests/e2e/wrapper-baseline.test.mjs fails when the prompt, the call shape or the extra calls of the default make contain something that is not listed here. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
baseline: A plain call: one model call, the brief as the whole prompt, no system prompt of ours, no tools, the platform's own output limit, no style or direction.

verdicts.accepted: Repeated paired comparisons (same brief, same model) on at least two briefs, every one up, none down; or a delivery or policy reason.
verdicts.provisional: In the default make on a measured but mixed, bundled or missing comparison. Named with who decided it and the comparison still needed; the test prints these.

entries.what: Anthropic's frontend-design guidance, unmodified (src/taste/frontend-design.md), as the system prompt.
entries.note: Same model, same brief; the only difference is the guidance as the system prompt. Two briefs, both up, none down.

evidence.brief: a landing page for a small accounting software company for teams

entries.what: For a landing, home, marketing, product or company brief: first-draft's own guidance after the frontend-design guidance (the human side, not the AI side; one bold brand colour and one accent; the nine-point hero; the facts rule).
entries.note: PR 76 reports one live run each way on one landing brief (not named there): the critic scored 8/10 before and after, hero 9 of 9 and not the AI side after, 4 host findings before and 0 after. The critic is the same model and PR 76 itself says it is not proof of a gain.
entries.needed: Plain model plus the frontend-design guidance against the same plus this one, on at least two landing briefs, scored by a reviewer beside each other.

entries.what: Reply is one complete, self-contained HTML document with its CSS inside.
entries.reason: The host saves and draws one HTML file; any other reply is not a page.

entries.what: Google Fonts named in a link or @import are embedded by the host.
entries.reason: States what the host does with fonts so the page does not need the network; it restricts nothing.

entries.what: Images are inline SVG, CSS or data: URIs; a remote image is blocked.
entries.reason: The exported page loads nothing from the network, so a remote image shows empty (test/make.test.mjs).

entries.what: The product's own data is specific and believable; claims about the product (logos, testimonials, ratings, counts) are never invented, or are labelled as a sample.
entries.reason: An owner decision about honesty, not a design restriction (2026-10-24). It replaced the engine rule that labelled all sample content, which produced "Placeholder quote" and "concept design" copy (bake-off cause 2).

entries.what: Script may run once; the host keeps what the first render shows, without the script.
entries.reason: Where Chrome is installed the host draws the page once into a static document; the sentence says what survives.

entries.what: Write no script: the page is shown as a static document.
entries.reason: Without Chrome the page cannot be drawn, so script would not run in the exported document.

entries.what: With several options and no direction named, one extra call plans a direction per option for the brief; each draw is told its direction.
entries.note: It replaced a fixed list of novelty styles (editorial, oled-neon, bento), which the bake-off named as cause 1 of the weak notes app. No paired plain-vs-planned comparison exists.
entries.needed: Three options with planned directions against three plain draws of the same brief, scored side by side.

entries.what: The host measures the drawn page (overflow at 390px, text under a fixed bar, clipped or unreadable text, a stray close control, a strong grid, more than three hues) and sends the model back once with exactly those findings.

In the retained dashboard cell it fired once, on text under the tab bar in light and dark; that cell scored 7 against 8 before, for a phone defect the host now also measures.
